scenario_description: Elena has begun teaching an assigned morning class at Oakwood Elementary, but the school laptop she needs for the lesson portal, student attendance, and the only copy of her lesson materials suddenly shuts down and will not restart. The active lesson cannot continue as planned because she has no paper materials or separate attendance list. The need becomes sufficiently observable at event3, when Elena reports both that the lesson has started and that the required laptop has failed. A later office message identifies a spare Chromebook that can be collected, while subsequent messages establish that students are waiting and the replacement must be obtained immediately. Proactive help can materially restore the lesson by requesting and coordinating the spare device and notifying the substitute coordinator.

parameter.subject: August 6 substitute assignment at Oakwood Elementary
parameter.body: Your substitute assignment is confirmed for Thursday, August 6, 2026, at Oakwood Elementary, 1850 Indianola Avenue, Columbus, Ohio. Report to Room 108 by 7:50 AM for a fifth-grade morning class. The class uses the school laptop to open the lesson materials, record attendance, and access the day's activities. Coverage begins at 8:05 AM.

parameter.content: I am in Room 108 at Oakwood and have checked in. The fifth-grade students are here, and I am getting the laptop and lesson portal ready for the 8:05 class.

The class has started, but the school laptop shut down while I was opening the lesson and will not restart or charge. The attendance list and all of today's lesson materials are on it; I do not have paper copies or another device, so I cannot continue the planned activity.

parameter.subject: Spare Chromebook available in the main office
parameter.body: A spare district Chromebook is available at Oakwood's main office for a substitute whose assigned laptop stops working. It is labeled Oakwood Spare 3 and can be checked out after the office records the borrower's name and school identification badge. The main office is across from Room 108, and the device is ready now.

parameter.subject: Room 108 class waiting for lesson access
parameter.body: The fifth-grade class in Room 108 is waiting to begin the scheduled online reading activity. The first activity should start by 8:25 because the room is shared with another group at 9:30. Please contact the main office if you need the spare Chromebook.

parameter.content: Oakwood just told me the spare Chromebook will be held for Room 108 only until 8:30, after which it may be assigned to another classroom. Please let me know as soon as the device issue is handled so I can update the assignment record.
